roles.name: staff
roles.description: Employee or contractor

roles.name: employee
roles.description: Employee self-service access to leave, claims, payslips, and personal info

roles.name: contractor
roles.description: Limited access for timekeeping, payments, and project-related data

roles.name: manager
roles.description: Responsible for a cost center, becomes the cost center owner

roles.name: hrms_admin
roles.description: Full access to HRMS system configuration, roles, and permissions

roles.name: hr_director
roles.description: Oversees HR strategy, policy, and compliance across the organization

roles.name: hr_manager
roles.description: Manages day-to-day HR operations including recruitment, payroll, and employee relations

roles.name: hr_businesspartner
roles.description: Acts as HR Business Partner aligning HR with business unit goals

roles.name: hr_executive
roles.description: Handles routine HR tasks like employee records, queries, and document management

roles.name: hr_recruiter
roles.description: Manages job postings, candidates, and recruitment process

roles.name: hr_payrollspecialist
roles.description: Processes payroll, deductions, tax, and statutory contributions

roles.name: hr_compensationbenefits
roles.description: Manages salary structures, benefits, and allowances

roles.name: hr_trainingofficer
roles.description: Coordinates employee training, courses, and certifications

roles.name: hr_performancespecialist
roles.description: Manages KPIs, appraisals, and performance review cycles

roles.name: hr_employeerelations
roles.description: Handles grievances, engagement, and disciplinary actions

roles.name: hr_financemanager
roles.description: Oversees HR-related financial reporting and payroll cost approvals

roles.name: hr_complianceofficer
roles.description: Ensures HR compliance with labor laws, health & safety, and regulations

roles.name: department_manager
roles.description: Approves leave, performance reviews, and manages team structure

roles.name: supervisor
roles.description: Monitors attendance, approves timesheets, and manages daily operations

roles.name: auditor
roles.description: Read-only access for HRMS audits and compliance checks
